grade.notes: No winner or overall score is assigned, and the condition identity is not inferred. Initial scoring is limited to evidence available before the audit index; later retrieval results and future holdout material are not credited to initial judgment. The future holdout F1 is reviewer-only context and was marked not applicable rather than scored as a missed answer. No numeric confidence threshold or forced accept/reject was imposed; high-confidence unsupported acceptance is no in both stages because neither stage accepted. Volume, selected-item count, and returned payload size are exposure/cost proxies, not proof of cognitive effort. Missing evidence was treated as unverified/insufficient rather than confirmed incorrect implementation. This is C13-only scoring; it is not compared with or used to claim replication of S01/SH2, and synthetic payload performance is not treated as naturalistic evidence.
